remaining_gaps: Clauses 1-101, 1-102(a) and 1-102(b) rest on sections 7(a) and 8 of the Defense Department Overseas Teachers Pay and Personnel Practices Act (20 U.S.C. 905 and 906) and on Executive Order 10000 (set out under 5 U.S.C. 5941). The current text of 20 U.S.C. 905 and 906 and the current text and status of Executive Order 10000 are not held (only Code notes naming EO 12228 are held), so whether the authority statute and the incorporated regulations were in force on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided from held text. Clauses 1-102(c) and 1-103 are supported by the held text of 38 U.S.C. 707 (jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t38-s707.txt), but the claim needs every clause decided. Missing source: current text of 20 U.S.C. 905 and 906 (release point 119-121 or later) and of EO 10000 as amended.

Three inventory and clause-state gaps. (1) The dossier inventory omits section 1-204 (guidelines on time limits for voluntary compliance), which the held Federal Register text prints as 1-204 with an irregular dash; an inventory correction with exact character spans is needed. (2) Section 1-305 (Attorney General chairs the Interagency Coordinating Council of section 507 of the Rehabilitation Act, 29 U.S.C. 794c) cannot be decided because the text and current status of 29 U.S.C. 794c are not held (it is not in jobs/current-law/output/usc-sections or jobs/theophilus-sources). (3) Sections 1-301 (implementation plan to OMB) and 1-403 (agency plans within 60 days after a date set by the Attorney General) are one-time commands; no held source shows whether they were performed or when, so neither an operative current predicate nor a dated performance end can be supported. Missing sources: 29 U.S.C. 794c current text with its amendment history, and a held record of the Attorney General implementation plan and the date set under 1-403.

The held Code note for EO 12260 (CURRENT:EO:12260#0) prints only the preamble. The operative clauses implement the 1979 GATT Agreement on Government Procurement as defined in 19 U.S.C. 2518(1) and delegate functions under 19 U.S.C. 2511, 2512, 2514, 2515(c) and 2516. The current text of 19 U.S.C. 2511-2518 (as amended after the Uruguay Round Agreements Act, which replaced the 1979 Agreement with the WTO Agreement on Government Procurement) is not held, and no held source shows whether the 150,000 Special Drawing Right threshold of section 1-104 and the Agreement named in 1-101 still govern. Missing sources: current text of 19 U.S.C. 2511, 2512, 2514, 2515, 2516 and 2518, and the Trade Representative Federal Register threshold determinations under section 1-104.
